newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Best Wide year net profit higher.
newsitem.headline: Best Wide year net profit higher.

text.p: Exceptional items 13.18 gain vs 24.72 gain (see note)
Company name Best Wide Group Ltd
NOTE - Best Wide Group, engages in overseas garment manufacturing and real estate investment and development.

The adoption of the Statement of Standard Accounting Practice No. 17 requires a restatement of the profit on disposal of properties for the year ended March 31, 1995, because a revaluation surplus of approximately HK$1.10 million relating to the leasehold properties disposal of the during that year had been included in arriving at the profit on disposal of the said properties. Accordingly, each of the exceptional items and the net profit for the 1995 have been reduced.
Comparative share earnings has been adjusted as result of the change in the accounting policy as mentioned above.
Net is after an exceptional gain on disposal of business.
Total dividend for year is nil vs nil.
